record.paper_title: Noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations: some results and open problems
record.context_brief: extend residue theorem beyond proper support
record.original_question: Theorem 3.12 proves a meromorphic continuation and residue formula for tr(Q A^{-z}) when A is a positive transversally elliptic operator with positive transversal principal symbol and Q lies in Psi^{l,-infinity}(M, F, E). Can this theorem be extended to the case where Q belongs to the completed algebra Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) and its symbol, viewed as an element of C^infinity(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2}), is not properly supported?

evidence.quote: Theorem 3.12 ([37]). Let A in Psi^m(M, E) be a transversally elliptic operator with a positive transversal principal symbol... For any Q in Psi^{l,-infinity}(M, F, E), l in Z, the function z -> tr(QA^{-z}) is holomorphic...
Problem 3.13. To extend Theorem 3.12 to the case when the symbol of Q in Psi-bar^{0,-infinity}(M, F, E) (which belongs to C^infinity(G_FN, L(pi^*E) tensor |T G_N|^{1/2})) is not properly supported.
One can expect that this result holds in the case when the symbol of Q is exponentially decreasing at infinity.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,F)$ be a compact Riemannian foliated manifold with a holonomy-invariant transverse Riemannian structure, and let $E\to M$ be a Hermitian vector bundle. Let $\Psi^{m,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ denote the algebra of transversal pseudodifferential operators (the noncommutative residue/transverse pseudodifferential calculus associated with $(M,F)$), and let $\overline{\Psi}{}^{0,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ be its completion whose elements are realized via symbols in $C^\infty(\mathcal{G}_{FN}, \mathcal{L}(\pi^*E)\otimes |T\mathcal{G}_N|^{1/2})$, where $\mathcal{G}_{FN}$ is the transverse holonomy groupoid, $\pi:\mathcal{G}_{FN}\to M$ the source projection, and $|T\mathcal{G}_N|^{1/2}$ the half-density bundle along its fibres.

Suppose $A\in\Psi^m(M,E)$ ($m>0$) is a transversally elliptic operator (in the sense of the transverse calculus) with positive transversal principal symbol, so that $A$ admits complex powers $A^{-z}$. It is known that for every $Q\in\Psi^{l,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ ($l\in\mathbb{Z}$), the function $z\mapsto \mathrm{tr}(QA^{-z})$ admits a meromorphic continuation to $\mathbb{C}$ with an explicit residue formula.

Question: Does the same meromorphic continuation and residue formula extend to all $Q\in\overline{\Psi}{}^{0,-\infty}(M,F,E)$ whose symbol (viewed as an element of $C^\infty(\mathcal{G}_{FN},\mathcal{L}(\pi^*E)\otimes |T\mathcal{G}_N|^{1/2})$) is not required to be properly supported—in particular, when the symbol is merely exponentially decreasing at infinity along the fibres of $\mathcal{G}_{FN}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem in Kordyukov's survey on noncommutative spectral geometry of Riemannian foliations. Web searches reveal related work by Kordyukov on Egorov's theorem and zeta functions for transversally elliptic operators on foliated manifolds, but no published resolution of the extension to non-properly-supported symbols in the completed transverse calculus. Status is therefore taken as open.

status_evidence.title: Egorov's theorem for transversally elliptic operators on foliated manifolds and noncommutative geodesic flow
status_evidence.snippet: Kordyukov's work establishing Egorov-type and trace formulas for transversally elliptic operators on foliated manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework of the transverse pseudodifferential calculus on foliations exists, but the extension of the residue/trace formula to the completed algebra with non-properly-supported symbols is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Index theory and non-commutative geometry on foliated manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Kordyukov's program on transverse calculus and noncommutative geometry of foliations.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the extension to non-properly supported symbols in the completed algebra is reported.
